projects.name: TIM NextGen DC Corporation acquisition (three Philippines data centers)
projects.quote: We completed our acquisition of all outstanding shares of TIM NextGen DC Corporation, consisting of three data centers in the Philippines, for total purchase consideration of $183 million.

projects.name: Strategic land acquisitions for retail and xScale capacity (Amsterdam, Chicago, London, Milan, Mumbai, Toronto)
projects.location: greater Amsterdam, Chicago, London, Milan, Mumbai and Toronto metros
projects.quote: We closed strategic land acquisitions in several locations, including the greater Amsterdam, Chicago, London, Milan, Mumbai and Toronto metros, which will support approximately 1 GW of retail and xScale capacity.
